assignments.reason: Akhilat Shabbat (Shabbat eating) is the holy act that gives strength to the feet/legs and transforms the shortened steps into a broad path (derekh kevushah). Its essential nature is the sacred Shabbat dimension — it belongs to the Shabbat/walking domain of Package 1. While Package 1 is labeled 'evil' for its dominant nodes (chilul Shabbat, shortened steps), the Shabbat eating is the positive pole within the same thematic cluster. The Rebbe explicitly links it to the legs receiving strength ('duk be-khakhei ve-tishkach ba-raglin') and to the repair of the pesi'ot ktzarot — the very nodes that define Package 1.

Nittaken chilul Shabbat (the repair of Shabbat desecration) is the rectified state of the degraded walking — the shortened steps become wide steps and a broad path. Its essential nature is the same domain as chilul Shabbat itself (Package 1), but from the positive/repaired angle. The Rebbe states explicitly: 'al ken al yedei akhilat Shabbat nittaken chilul Shabbat, she-hu bechina pesi'ot ktzarot' — the repair IS the domain of the shortened steps made whole.
